question: For how many days is the Tirupati Tirumala Brahmotsavam organised?
solution:
The correct answer is **__9__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Tirupati Tirumala Brahmotsavam is organised for 9 days.
 
• It is one of the most significant and auspicious festivals in South India.
 
• The festival takes place at the Sri Venkateswara Temple in Tirumala, Tirupati.
 
• It attracts millions of devotees from all over the world.
 
• The Brahmotsavam festival is celebrated in honor of Lord Venkateswara, an incarnation of Lord Vishnu.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Sri Venkateswara Temple in Tirumala, Tirupati, is among the most visited and wealthiest temples in the world. Here are some more insights:
 
 
• It is located in the hill town of Tirumala, near Tirupati, in the Chittoor district of Andhra Pradesh, India.
 
• The temple is dedicated to Lord Venkateswara, a form of Vishnu, who is believed to have appeared here to save mankind from trials and troubles of Kali Yuga.
 
• The temple's architecture is a brilliant example of Dravidian architecture with its gopuram (tower) being a distinctive feature.
 
• The annual Brahmotsavam festival is the most important and auspicious event celebrated in this temple.
 
• The prasadam offered at this temple, known as "Tirupati Laddu", is famous worldwide for its unique taste.
